GmSquadCardDetail.Name: GM Squad Card Detail
GmSquadCardDetail.Hint: Choose how much squad information your GM or Assistant cards show. Full adds captain and morale summaries; Compact keeps member count and mode; Minimal keeps name and initiative. Controls, hidden indicators, and individual member rows stay available. Saved for your user in this world.

PlayerMoraleVisibility.Name: Player Morale Visibility
PlayerMoraleVisibility.Hint: Choose whether players see SCI's Living/Holding/Broken summaries and member morale badges. Visible Members counts only members that player can see. This controls tracker display; chat messages and Foundry condition icons keep their own visibility.

AutoCollapseGroups.Name: Auto Collapse Groups
AutoCollapseGroups.Hint: When enabled, the active combatant's group will automatically expand on their turn, while others collapse (unless pinned).

DefaultGroupPinned.Name: Pin New Groups by Default
DefaultGroupPinned.Hint: When enabled, newly created groups will be pinned (stay expanded during auto-collapse). You can still toggle pinning per group.

DefaultInitiativeMode.Name: Default Initiative Mode
DefaultInitiativeMode.Hint: The default initiative calculation method for newly created groups. Average: mean of all rolls. Highest: best roll. Lowest: worst roll. Median: middle value. Captain: use the designated captain's roll. Shared: one roll that every member carries.

CarouselSquadCards.Name: Show squad cards in the carousel
CarouselSquadCards.Hint: Collapses each squad to one card in Carousel Combat Tracker. The squad taking its turn expands beside its card.

CarouselExpandDirection.Name: Expand direction
CarouselExpandDirection.Hint: How the squad taking its turn shows its members. Away from the carousel means down from the card when the carousel is across the top, up if there isn't room below, and sideways when the carousel is vertical. One at a time keeps the bar the same width and cycles through the squad beside its card.

CarouselMemberOrder.Name: Member order
CarouselMemberOrder.Hint: Turn order keeps the list still while the current member moves along it. Current member first keeps them next to the card, with those still to act behind them and those who have acted moving to the end. This doesn't apply to One at a time.

CarouselMembersShown.Name: Members shown when expanded
CarouselMembersShown.Hint: How many members an expanded squad shows at once. The scroll wheel moves through the rest. One at a time always shows one.

CarouselPreviewCount.Name: Mini portraits on a collapsed card
CarouselPreviewCount.Hint: How many member portraits a collapsed card shows. Set to 0 for none.

CarouselCollapse.Name: Squads that collapse
CarouselCollapse.Hint: Keeping friendly squads expanded lets players see every member of their own side.

CarouselDefeated.Name: Defeated members
CarouselDefeated.Hint: Dimmed members stay in the expanded list. Otherwise they only count toward the squad's total.

CarouselFadeEdges.Name: Fade the edges of expanded squads
CarouselFadeEdges.Hint: Members at an edge fade out when more of the squad is hidden that way. The current member never fades, and hovering a member brings it back.

CarouselShowHealth.Name: Show the squad's health on the card
CarouselShowHealth.Hint: A bar of the squad's total hit points. Only GMs and Assistants see it.

CarouselShowNext.Name: Highlight the squad that's up next
CarouselShowNext.Hint: A glow on the next squad's card. Nothing lights up if the next combatant isn't in a squad.

CarouselDimDefeated.Name: Dim fully defeated squads
CarouselDimDefeated.Hint: Greys out a card once every member is down.

CarouselShowMorale.Name: Show Broken members on the card
CarouselShowMorale.Hint: Players only see this when the Player Morale Visibility setting allows it.

CarouselShowCaptain.Name: Show the captain's crown on the card

EncounterSquads.Name: Encounter Squads
EncounterSquads.Hint: When a dnd5e Encounter actor is placed and its members join combat, group them into one squad named after the Encounter, with the first Important NPC as captain. This needs dnd5e's Encounter placement setting to add combatants, which is off by default.

VisibilitySyncMode.Name: Visibility Sync Mode
VisibilitySyncMode.Hint: Bidirectional: hiding/showing a token on the canvas or combat tracker syncs both. Tracker Only: only the group toggle controls visibility (canvas tokens unaffected). None: systems are fully independent (legacy behavior).

GroupTokenHighlight.Name: Group Token Highlight on Hover
GroupTokenHighlight.Hint: When hovering over a group header, highlight all tokens belonging to that group on the canvas.

DebugLevel.Name: Debug Logging Level
DebugLevel.Hint: Off = No debug logs. Normal = Key operations only. Verbose = All details including render cycles and individual rolls.

EnableMcpDiagnostics.Name: Enable MCP Diagnostics
EnableMcpDiagnostics.Hint: Advanced GM-only diagnostics, including module validation, client refresh, and confirm-gated fixture automation. Leave this disabled unless you are intentionally debugging or testing this module.

AllowMutatingDiagnostics.Name: Allow Mutating MCP Diagnostics
AllowMutatingDiagnostics.Hint: Extra safety gate for active-scene fixture automation and cleanup. Leave disabled outside dedicated test worlds or active module maintenance.

MoraleEnabled.Name: Enable Morale System
MoraleEnabled.Hint: Enables the squad morale system. When disabled, morale buttons and auto-prompts are hidden.

MoraleAutoPromptThreshold.Name: Morale Auto-Prompt Threshold (%)
MoraleAutoPromptThreshold.Hint: When a group's living members drop to this percentage of starting size, the GM is prompted to roll morale. Set to 0 to disable auto-prompts.

MoraleStatusEffect.Name: Morale Failure Status Effect
MoraleStatusEffect.Hint: Which status effect to apply when a creature fails its morale check.

MoraleMobConfidenceDivisor.Name: Mob Confidence Divisor
MoraleMobConfidenceDivisor.Hint: Mob confidence bonus = +1 per this many living members. Default: +1 per 3 living members. Can be overridden per-group.

MoraleEffectDuration.Name: Morale Effect Duration (rounds)
MoraleEffectDuration.Hint: How many rounds the morale failure effect lasts. Set to 0 for permanent (must be removed manually). A combatant stays Broken until rallied or cleared, even after a timed effect ends.

InitiativeModeLong.Shared: Shared (One roll for the whole squad)
